slides.title: Same V8. Which one do you buy?
slides.body: Both run the 4.7 2UZ-FE. One is mid-size, one is full-size. Swipe for the differences that matter.

slides.credit: Prado 120, the GX 470's twin · Seek liam, CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.title: Smaller, lighter, cheaper.
slides.body: Five-speed in every year, 109.8 in wheelbase, EPA 14/18 mpg. Biggest tire without a lift: about 31.5 in.

slides.credit: Land Cruiser 100 · Andries Oudshoorn · CC BY-SA 2.0
slides.title: Room, clearance, 33s.
slides.body: 9.8 in of clearance ('05), a usable third row and 33-inch tires with no lift. 1998–99 trucks offered a factory rear locker.

slides.credit: Land Cruiser 100 · Andries Oudshoorn · CC BY-SA 2.0
slides.title: Family and towing: the 100. Tight trails and budget: the GX.
slides.body: Best 100 Series years: 2003–07, with the five-speed. On the GX, mid-2004 on gets the 6,500-lb hitch.

end.title: Which would you buy?
end.body: Every spec, what breaks and prices, side by side.
